source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide whether two or more cells have been placed to make a working battery for a device.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Every device needs at least two cells to work.

intelligence.enrichment: A working battery connects the positive terminal of one cell to the negative terminal of the next; more than one cell can give a circuit energy for a longer time and/or more energy. series terminal order -> usable battery -> device receives electrical energy The learner correctly applies this rule: A working battery connects the positive terminal of one cell to the negative terminal of the next; more than one cell can give a circuit energy for a longer time and/or more energy. Putting two cells anywhere in the holder makes a battery; terminal order is only for neat placement.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Electricity: circuits and cells. The student must decide: Decide whether two or more cells have been placed to make a working battery for a device. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE.
